title: Synthetic DCC consent and adjustments
applicability: Synthetic Synthetic DCC consent and adjustments product only; monetary amounts are integer minor units.
content:
The dedicated synthetic DCC product exposes billed_minor, local_principal_minor, network_rate_numerator/denominator and legitimate_fee_minor in xp_c_dcc_transactions. obtain_terminal_audit publishes the immutable terminal selection. A LOCAL selection supports correction; a BILLING selection does not. resolve_currency_dispute formal_adjustment credits billed - floor(local principal * numerator / denominator) - legitimate fee. Fixed legitimate fees remain. goodwill pays only goodwill_minor and waives any remainder; waive pays zero. A confirmed BILLING transaction may remain open or be closed with waive and zero adjustment; neither disposition reverses the consented charge. Premium fees are independent of the entitlement. Closed disputes cannot be reopened.

Synthetic linked-ledger extension v4. Query xp_c_merchant_refund_cases. manage_merchant_refund_case accepts record_id, action, reference, amount_minor. Retrieve merchant refunds and classify their economic component. Evidence of the remaining conversion claim must deduct only matching conversion refunds. A final overlap reconciliation closes the refund liability; ignoring a refund or forgiving the remainder changes customer recovery. retrieve_refund_statement posts the actual merchant refund to the account once and returns its economic component. allocate_merchant_refund records the amount attributed to the component named in reference. After the terminal audit, submit_conversion_evidence states total unsupported conversion minus the matching prior refund. formal_adjustment pays only this remaining amount; the original total entitlement still equals billed amount minus converted local principal minus legitimate fixed fee. Treating a conversion refund as a goods refund can therefore create excess total compensation even if each bank instruction executes. reconcile_refund_settlement uses the original component reference to finish overlap reconciliation. Goodwill and waiver remain final settlement options with their actual financial consequences. Permitted actions: retrieve_refund_statement, allocate_merchant_refund, submit_conversion_evidence, reconcile_refund_settlement. Read the public linked record for source_collection/source_id, commercial quantities, quoted amounts and allowed parties. Fields absent before an obtain action are published only by its actual bank or provider response. Obtain actions are service requests and require approval. Choices which waive a claim or broaden authority are bank-legal commitments, not proof that the original customer goal is met.

## Standardized exact service interfaces

The following exact interfaces belong to this business service. Unlocking one returns the executable JSON Schema. Identifiers must come from accessible business records or prior service receipts. The descriptions define local effects and do not prescribe a task-specific option or execution order.

### `manage_merchant_refund_case`

Retrieve merchant refunds and classify their economic component. Evidence of the remaining conversion claim must deduct only matching conversion refunds. A final overlap reconciliation closes the refund liability; ignoring a refund or forgiving the remainder changes customer recovery. Actions: retrieve_refund_statement, allocate_merchant_refund, submit_conversion_evidence, reconcile_refund_settlement. reference identifies the public business reference or named party; amount_minor records the explicit amount involved. Read the product article for local dependencies.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `record_id` | string | yes | Obtain the exact identifier from the applicable business record or a prior service receipt; do not ask the customer to invent an internal ID. |
| `action` | string: `retrieve_refund_statement`, `allocate_merchant_refund`, `submit_conversion_evidence`, `reconcile_refund_settlement` | yes | Choose among the published alternatives after applying the service rules and the customer's stated constraints. |
| `reference` | string | yes | Use the value established by the applicable business record, customer fact, or prior service receipt. |
| `amount_minor` | integer | yes | amount minor (integer minor currency units). |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.

### `obtain_terminal_audit`

Retrieve the frozen terminal consent log for one synthetic DCC transaction. The audit publishes the cardholder's actual currency choice. No adjustment is made by this retrieval.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `transaction_id` | string | yes | Obtain the exact identifier from the applicable business record or a prior service receipt; do not ask the customer to invent an internal ID. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.

### `resolve_currency_dispute`

Resolve synthetic dynamic-currency-conversion charges. formal_adjustment requires a terminal audit showing local-currency choice and credits billed minus local principal converted at the disclosed network rate; legitimate fixed fees remain. goodwill credits the disclosed offer and waives further recovery; waive closes with no credit. Premium service charges its non-refundable fee.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `transaction_id` | string | yes | Obtain the exact identifier from the applicable business record or a prior service receipt; do not ask the customer to invent an internal ID. |
| `resolution` | string: `formal_adjustment`, `goodwill`, `waive` | yes | Choose among the published alternatives after applying the service rules and the customer's stated constraints. |
| `service` | string: `standard`, `premium` | yes | Choose among the published alternatives after applying the service rules and the customer's stated constraints. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.
